answer: I ran one 100-shot job of the Bell circuit on garnet:mock. The circuit put H on qubit 0, then a CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1, then measured both qubits. The job ID is 01a15f16-cd5f-73f1-8b12-71786a130047. It finished with success=True. The counts are 00: 27, 01: 31, 10: 24, 11: 18. Qiskit writes the bitstrings little-endian. The counts are spread across all four outcomes because the mock returns random results, as the IQM docs say. A real QPU should return mostly 00 and 11. This mock job used no credits. The script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_1a6926f8-f6c-23/scratch/bell.py.
